scope: Numerical simulation; no hardware safety or experimental tomato accuracy claim

geometry.quality_metric: released cap versus reference curved thickness profile, not uniform thickness
geometry.shape_evaluator: Area-weighted proper rigid registration of corresponding cap surface nodes, no scaling or deformable fit; compare five X-ray cut-to-exterior thicknesses in registered reference coordinates. Missing/multiple surface intersections invalidate the metric.
geometry.pose_metric: Report the rigid registration separately; cap shape registration must not conceal remainder drift or blade-relative displacement.

mechanics.production_law: preserve existing tensile-qualified model; extensions versioned separately
mechanics.self_contact_status: whole-fruit combined volume/self-contact not yet qualified
mechanics.candidate: Versioned moving-frame mixed-mode cohesive law, explicit unilateral full-surface contact, unchanged bulk spring/barrier parameters, checked actual-stored volume updates. Component verification does not qualify sustained dynamics.

mounted_coupon.gate_provenance: Synthetic diagnostic engineering bounds fixed before execution; impulse/replay bounds carried from qualified short exchange. Not physical safe loads.

sustained_support.gate_provenance: proposed engineering criteria; feasibility must be tested, no retuning after observing a failure

registered_inputs.coordinates: Saved metre-scale blade-local CAD, actual PhysX link world pose xyzw; tool wrench expressed in world coordinates about actual tool COM. Newton deformation uses rest-relative storage, physical geometry reconstructed in float64.
registered_inputs.inertia_source: Read actual mounted-body COM/inertia from the fixed scene at runtime and archive; no guessed uniform-solid inertia substitution.

board_interaction.stop: Any blade-board contact stops the experiment. Actual full CAD minimum world Z must remain positive with declared route-specific tracking margin.
board_interaction.route_status: Existing dry route is laterally offset by 90 mm and is not a contact-capable cutting route. A fresh 23A qualification is required; minimum clearance cannot be inferred from old dry motion.

clocks.status: Diagnostic starting value, not qualified for full-target cutting. Time-step refinement must pass before adopting a cutting clock.
clocks.ownership: PhysX owns actual robot; Newton owns deformable. Exchange measured accepted pose/wrench at synchronized timestamps. Never teleport the blade to the commanded path.

fracture_eligibility.definition_required: Swept actual finite CAD cutting-front band against current-deformation material footprints, plus a documented local overlap/state rule; no time, depth or proximity-only activation and no permanently active row.
fracture_eligibility.material_areas: Keep existing traction and fracture-energy areas; geometric Voronoi footprints are eligibility geometry only.

future_cut_gates.shallow_cut: Requires P1/P2 and 23A/B, actual mounted whole-target force/work traces and a new bounded preregistered case.
future_cut_gates.release: All 47 cohesive histories fully failed, no cross-piece material graph ties, exactly two bulk components, blade absent at least one second, free cap motion under the qualified support/contact model. Damage fraction or tool depth alone cannot pass.
future_cut_gates.refinement_formula: abs(a-b)/max(abs(a),abs(b),floor); compare two finest independent levels and investigate nonmonotone results.
future_cut_gates.floor_provenance: Synthetic engineering resolution floors chosen before cutting, not measured sensor resolution or hardware limits.
future_cut_gates.whole_system_work_budget: OPEN: derive fixture-specific independent budget including robot kinetic energy, actuator work, gravity, fixture/base reactions, contact, bulk, cohesion/fracture and numerical loss before cut execution. Equal force arrays alone cannot close it.
future_cut_gates.loaded_reset: Milestone 22 post-cut checks require an actual coupled cut first; seed/history/contact queues, velocities, articulation state, controller targets, cloth/bulk state and randomization state must reset and replay.

evidence_scope: Coordinate covariance, underlying matrix, energy and original analytic integration components pass. L-BFGS recursion and integration require separate controls. No long support, cutting or training gate is closed.

numerical_backend.name: Float64 fraction-to-volume-boundary positive-tensile-curvature block-Jacobi GN L-BFGS/PCG candidate
numerical_backend.canonical_source_values: Original mass, stiffness, cell volume, spring rest length, objective anchor choices, frame sign, material stiffness and fracture values retained. Simulation coordinates alone are translated.
numerical_backend.accepted_source_registry: unchanged 4032 nodes,33996 springs,16291 cells,5504 collision triangles,47 cohesive patches,25 remainder fixture nodes; cap unpinned
numerical_backend.nonlinear_stops: Original noncancelling impulse audit plus stricter per-node velocity-defect target, unchanged during the new frame test.
numerical_backend.line_search: Full unchanged incremental potential, Armijo1e-4,40halvings; conservative contact coverage and positive-volume paths; no rejected history commit.
numerical_backend.curvature_filter: sTy > max(1e-280 J,1e-10*norm(s)*norm(y)); otherwise skip; memory resets each physical step
numerical_backend.fallback: If the corrected direction fails its linear solve or descent test, clear memory and use the qualified plain global GN direction with the same true-residual gate.
numerical_backend.physics_change: None. Search matrix extended as declared; block Cholesky shift remains preconditioner-only.
numerical_backend.linear_preconditioner: Symmetrized normalized 3x3 Cholesky block Jacobi. Factorization-only relative shift 1e-12 then x10, at most 8 attempts when normalized pivot <=1e-14. No change to system matrix, exact forces, energy or physical parameters. Fail if no positive finite factor.
numerical_backend.true_linear_residual_gate: norm(Ap-b) <= max(5e-9*norm(b),1e-15 N); tighter floor only, no physical/nonlinear/replay gate relaxed.
numerical_backend.spring_search_matrix: Existing radial k*n*nT plus max(0,k*(1-l0/l))*(I-n*nT), assembled with full signed endpoint cross-blocks. This explicitly changes only the numerical search matrix, adding the positive tangential part of the exact spring Hessian. The exact central spring force/potential, rest length, material stiffness, mass, contact and acceptance gates are unchanged.
numerical_backend.qualification: Independent full-registry CPU-autograd tensile-energy HVP plus existing CPU bulk/contact/cohesive references passes three static cases. No mechanical/sustained support pass is inferred.
numerical_backend.volume_trial_strategy: For each nonlinear search trial, require conservative exact-cubic lower path bound J_lower > .1+.2*(J_current-.1). Retain at least 20% of current gap, equivalent to a maximum .8 approach fraction. Repeated valid trials may approach the same physical J>.1 boundary. No higher constitutive floor, force/energy change, altered final admissibility, or altered nonlinear/replay tolerance.
numerical_backend.scope: Numerical search safeguard; operator and dynamics qualification separate.

method_reference.scope: Two-loop limited-memory BFGS method; this custom geometry-constrained preconditioned integrator is not validated by citation alone.

registered_numerical_diagnostics: block preconditioner 3 static controls, 16 basic integration steps and strict 48-step/10ms two-episode replay pass. Longer support and time/contact convergence remain open.

temporal_refinement_study.provenance: Original standalone numerical sensitivity screen retained. Compare matching canonical source geometry/parameters and accepted clocks, saved final x/v, no fit or rescaling. A short screen is not full cutting convergence.
temporal_refinement_study.gating: Each setting must pass physical/numerical/admissibility and strict replay; failed or incomplete levels do not qualify finer/coarser settings. Compare finest two valid matched levels; refine further or report unconverged if discrepancy exceeds bounds.

method_reference_volume_safeguard.relation: Wachter & Biegler, Mathematical Programming106 (2006), Eq15, fraction-to-boundary for positive variables. Our nonlinear determinant-path adaptation and .8 choice are project numerical settings, independently tested; we do not implement their complete primal-dual filter method or inherit its convergence theorem.

preview.scope: Longer gravity/admissibility component only, no replay or ten-second settling pass

streamed_diagnostics.trace: Each accepted state receives the original independent force/energy/global and noncancelling nodal audits. All per-step audits and nonlinear traces stream to gzip JSONL; summary checkpoints do not replace raw records.
streamed_diagnostics.gates: Unchanged J>.1, board penetration<=.0001m, original fixed remainder nodes/free cap, no damage/eligibility, impulse/energy contracts, preflight displacement stop .02m. Two-episode tests retain replay<=1e-10m/1e-8m/s. No hidden warm-up or native-VBD/robot-step count.
streamed_diagnostics.scope: No actual mounted whole-target work, bounded load challenge, coupled fracture, loaded cutting reset, separation or training qualification.

states: prepared partial damage on unloading branch, live eligibility off
prepared fully failed cap with proper independent rotation and analytic freefall
prepared_history_components.unchanged: Source mass, stiffness, geometry, fracture budget, board, fixture and full contact; failed branch avoids constructing a vanished frame. Search strategy remains fraction-to-volume-boundary/Tangent/PCG.
prepared_history_components.ledger: Fresh safe cohesive force, skip zero failed stored-energy frame, explicitly add committed fracture dissipation. Original global/local/energy/replay budgets.
prepared_history_components.guard: This candidate refuses nonzero live eligibility before advancing state or history. Actual accepted fracture/geometry transaction remains unqualified.
prepared_history_components.scope: Prepared-history mechanics/operators only; no performed fracture, knife-driven separation, independent one-second release, full robot work or loaded cutting reset qualification.

gravity_preparation.potential: Original source bulk/cohesive/contact/board potential plus -sum(m*g dot (x-reference)); numerical mass regularization occurs in the search matrix only.
gravity_preparation.preserve: Original constitutive rest geometry, spring rest lengths, volumes, masses, fixture positions, cap freedom, material values, zero history and disabled eligibility. Prepared x is a new prestressed initial configuration, never a new stress-free rest mesh.
gravity_preparation.scope: A force-balanced initial-condition preparation only. Does not qualify the previous failed floating-target transient, stability under perturbations, ten-second dynamic support, time/contact convergence, actual mounted work or cutting. Any later prepared hold must identify and hash its initial-state file.
gravity_preparation.numerical_revision: Physical force/potential and all acceptance bounds remain unchanged. A poorly progressing corrected trial competes with a plain-GN trial on actual admissible potential; choose the better descending trial and clear stale memory if GN is selected. Larger positive-curvature memory affects search only.

poses: actual stalled static iterate, gravity load .1
accepted 250 ms gravity pose, full gravity
loaded_gradient_diagnostic.reference: Independent CPU autograd of full original bulk/cohesive/contact/board/gravity potential. Contact uses raw embedding arrays and independent CPU minimizing closest features, not native cached scatter coefficients.
loaded_gradient_diagnostic.scope: Posed loaded force/potential consistency only. No new mechanics, equilibrium, support or cutting qualification.

direct_static_search.linear_backend: CPU SciPy sparse LU with independent actual GPU BSR true residual
direct_static_search.scope: Zero physical-time preparation only; existing geometry, source parameters, force/potential, admissibility and final equilibrium gates unchanged. New prestressed initial state requires later dynamic hold/load checks. Old drop and settling failures remain failures.

cached_static_search.changes: Old sparse LU used as preconditioner only. Bounded CPU CG on actual current matrix; actual GPU true-residual gate unchanged; fresh sparse LU with bounded refinement on failure. No force, potential, acceptance or geometry change.
cached_static_search.previous_direct_attempt: Checkpoint-stopped incomplete for rescheduling, not a physical failure or pass.

global_frozen_pressure.scope: Frozen planar packet on original complete material registry. No packet generation, coverage, mechanics, mounted interval/work, support or cutting claim. Candidate explicitly refuses steps.
global_frozen_pressure.body_reaction_moment_origin: current physical soft point relative to actual tool COM

prepared_scene_hold.new_initial_condition: Zero-time, six-stage independently force-balanced full-gravity PRESTRESSED intact state. Original constitutive rest geometry/fixture retained. Not the old floating drop.
prerequisites: fresh full-gravity force balance and geometry checked before dynamic stepping
prepared_scene_hold.initial_contact_energy: Fresh full-surface detection/evaluation after each state reset, before taking the energy baseline.
prepared_scene_hold.target_gates: Original unchanged support global/local impulse, energy, volume, board, maximum source displacement and final-one-second maximum speed <=1 mm/s.
prepared_scene_hold.robot_gates: Inherited fixed-mount dry scene geometry, mount, speed, tracking and forbidden contact budgets; positive/clear monitor control; q/qd/tool replay <=1e-5 rad/2e-5 rad/s/2e-6 pose component.
prepared_scene_hold.scope: Actual parked robot and prepared target share episode timestamps. Blade must remain clear. No load challenge, actual mounted target feedback/work, performed fracture, cutting reset, separation or learning qualification.

engine_device_boundary.issue: Installed SimulationContext sets global Warp device to cpu at initialization; target custom kernels without explicit device must not execute against CUDA buffers under CPU default.
engine_device_boundary.repair: Explicitly select cuda:0 after PhysX setup/reset and after every PhysX step, before any custom target kernel call.
engine_device_boundary.prior_attempt: prepared_scene_screen_20261102_01 crashed after rigid monitor control, zero qualified target episode; preserved.
